title: Expedition 17 Automated Transfer Vehicle (ATV) Undocking
author: NASA/JSC
description: ISS017-E-015496 (5 Sept. 2008) --- Backdropped by a blanket of clouds, European Space Agency's (ESA) "Jules Verne" Automated Transfer Vehicle (ATV) continues its relative separation from the International Space Station.
